shared_elements: single frontally/laterally dominant anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole field
circular disc motif on the torso/chest area
carved relief of a single large humanoid figure with garment
justification: Both show a single large anthropomorphic figure filling the field, with a covered/adorned head and a prominent circular disc element on the chest or upper body, and both render the body in relief on a slab-like surface. But B is a naturalistic profile figure with articulated arms, hands holding an object, elaborate beard, fringed robe and modelled musculature, whereas A is a squat, blocky, frontal schematic figure with no articulated limbs and only abstract geometric bosses, roundels and bands standing in for features.
